issues.problem: The rewritten invariant says every continuation "is resumed exactly once, after it leaves its table through `removeValue`". It then names the follow-barrier withdrawal as one of the "Three paths [that] resume it later than it leaves". The merged code does the opposite. `withdraw` (EngineCommands.swift:176-186) resumes the waiter's continuation first (:178). Off the barrier it then sets `self.state.waiters[token] = nil` in the same turn (:184), which is an assignment, not `removeValue`. Behind the barrier it sets only `continuation = nil` (:180) and defers `.removal(token, …)` to the drain (:181). The record stays in `waiters` until `replayRemoval` removes it (EngineFollow.swift:1024-1031: `if let waiter = self.state.waiters[token], waiter.continuation == nil { self.state.waiters[token] = nil …`). So on the barrier path the caller is resumed turns BEFORE its record leaves the table. Shutdown also takes the table out by whole assignment (EngineShutdown.swift:61-62), not by `removeValue`. The base text (8d86acb: "resumed only through `removeValue` on its table") was stale, and the replacement is still false of the merged code.
